tables.audit_logs:
CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	entity_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	entity_id INTEGER, 
	old_value TEXT, 
	new_value TEXT, 
	performed_by VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
tables.campuses:
CREATE TABLE campuses (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	center_lat FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	center_lng FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	bounds_ne_lat FLOAT, 
	bounds_ne_lng FLOAT, 
	bounds_sw_lat FLOAT, 
	bounds_sw_lng FLOAT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
tables.discoveries:
CREATE TABLE discoveries (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	image_path VARCHAR(200), 
	location_name VARCHAR(100), 
	latitude FLOAT, 
	longitude FLOAT, 
	note TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
tables.cats:
CREATE TABLE cats (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	nickname VARCHAR(100), 
	gender VARCHAR(10), 
	neutered VARCHAR(10), 
	age_estimate VARCHAR(20), 
	color VARCHAR(50), 
	personality TEXT, 
	story TEXT, 
	location VARCHAR(100), 
	avatar VARCHAR(200), 
	personality_radar TEXT, 
	quote VARCHAR(120), 
	aliases VARCHAR(120), 
	relationships TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	campus_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(campus_id) REFERENCES campuses (id)
)
tables.feeding_points:
CREATE TABLE feeding_points (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	latitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	longitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	campus_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(campus_id) REFERENCES campuses (id)
)
tables.users:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	nickname VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(20), 
	avatar VARCHAR(200), 
	openid VARCHAR(100), 
	session_key VARCHAR(100), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	xp INTEGER, 
	level INTEGER, 
	longest_streak INTEGER, 
	token_version INTEGER, 
	campus_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(campus_id) REFERENCES campuses (id)
)
tables.cat_images:
CREATE TABLE cat_images (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	image_path VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	embedding_path VARCHAR(200), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
tables.daily_capsule_claims:
CREATE TABLE daily_capsule_claims (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	claim_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER, 
	sticker VARCHAR(10), 
	title VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_daily_capsule_claim UNIQUE (user_id, claim_date), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
tables.feeding_check_ins:
CREATE TABLE feeding_check_ins (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	point_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	food_remaining VARCHAR(20), 
	cats_seen INTEGER, 
	note TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(point_id) REFERENCES feeding_points (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.health_records:
CREATE TABLE health_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	record_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	record_date DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR(100), 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.invite_codes:
CREATE TABLE invite_codes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	used_by INTEGER, 
	used_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(used_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.notifications:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT, 
	related_id INTEGER, 
	related_type VARCHAR(20), 
	is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.posts:
CREATE TABLE posts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tags TEXT, 
	related_cat_id INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	likes_count INTEGER, 
	comments_count INTEGER, 
	post_type VARCHAR(20), 
	poll_options TEXT, 
	poll_data TEXT, 
	accepted_comment_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(related_cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
tables.route_checkins:
CREATE TABLE route_checkins (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	time_slot VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	stop_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_route_checkin UNIQUE (user_id, time_slot, stop_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
tables.sightings:
CREATE TABLE sightings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	image_path VARCHAR(200), 
	location VARCHAR(100), 
	location_name VARCHAR(100), 
	latitude FLOAT, 
	longitude FLOAT, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	activity_type VARCHAR(20), 
	note TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	spotted_by VARCHAR(50), 
	confirmations INTEGER, 
	grade VARCHAR(20), 
	weather VARCHAR(20), 
	mood VARCHAR(20), 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.user_badges:
CREATE TABLE user_badges (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	badge_key VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	earned_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_badge UNIQUE (user_id, badge_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.user_cat_follows:
CREATE TABLE user_cat_follows (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_cat_follow UNIQUE (user_id, cat_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
tables.user_collectibles:
CREATE TABLE user_collectibles (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	collectible_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	"key" VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	emoji VARCHAR(10), 
	extra_data TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_collectible UNIQUE (user_id, collectible_type, "key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.post_comments:
CREATE TABLE post_comments (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES posts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.post_images:
CREATE TABLE post_images (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	image_path VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES posts (id)
)
tables.post_likes:
CREATE TABLE post_likes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES posts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.post_poll_votes:
CREATE TABLE post_poll_votes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	option_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_post_poll_vote UNIQUE (post_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES posts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.reports:
CREATE TABLE reports (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reported_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20), 
	handled_by INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES posts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reported_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(handled_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.sighting_confirmations:
CREATE TABLE sighting_confirmations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sighting_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sighting_confirmation UNIQUE (sighting_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sighting_id) REFERENCES sightings (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
tables.sighting_votes:
CREATE TABLE sighting_votes (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sighting_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_sighting_vote UNIQUE (sighting_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(sighting_id) REFERENCES sightings (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cat_id) REFERENCES cats (id)
)
